channel.title: Business Today India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Today India (businesstoday.in)

item.title: YRF bypasses Netflix's ₹215 crore offer for 'Alpha', Alia-Sharvari spy thriller to release in theatres: Report
item.description: Despite speculation that the Alia Bhatt and Sharvari starrer might bypass cinemas for an OTT debut, YRF has reiterated its commitment to a theatrical release.

item.title: Trump imposes 126% duty on Indian solar imports: What it means for US energy, will solar panels get costly and more
item.description: These measures follow federal determinations that foreign subsidies have allowed exporters to unfairly undercut American-made products.

item.title: NCERT’s new Class 8 chapter on ‘judicial corruption’ sparks row, CJI warns against defaming court
item.description: The revised book, released by the National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT), for the first time includes a detailed discussion on corruption within the judiciary and the mounting pendency of cases across courts

item.title: OpenAI appoints Arvind KC as Chief People Officer to guide next phase of AI growth
item.description: Arvind KC joins OpenAI as the new Chief People Officer. He will be reporting to Jason Kwon, OpenAI’s chief strategy officer.

item.title: Jharkhand air ambulance crash: No black box on board; probe to rely on ATC data, eyewitness accounts, say officials
item.description: The aircraft did not carry a black box, a factor that investigators say will complicate efforts to determine the exact cause of the accident.

item.title: Deepinder Goyal hints at launch of ‘Temple’ wearable, waitlist to open soon
item.description: The health-tech wearable named Temple could launch soon for the public. Deepinder Goyal teases the device, with the waitlist opening soon.

item.title: SpiceJet shares crash nearly 45% in a month; analysts remain 'bearish'
item.description: SpiceJet: On the earnings front, the airline reported a consolidated net loss of Rs 261.38 crore in the December-ended quarter compared with a net profit of Rs 20.43 crore in the year-ago period.

item.title: AI that can replace entire research teams: Anthropic warns of disruptive impact on jobs
item.description: The policy identifies as especially risky AI that can “fully automate, or otherwise dramatically accelerate, the work of large, top-tier teams of human researchers,” a scenario that threatens jobs across science, engineering, finance, software development and other knowledge-intensive fields.

item.title: India, GCC sign Joint Statement to kick off detailed FTA talks, as trade hits $178.56 bn in FY25
item.description: The document was signed by Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal and GCC Secretary General Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi, with senior officials and delegations from both sides present at the ceremony
